name: Anekawa Ayane
source:
Likes: [url=/c119879]Shun[/url], doing housework, friends
Dislikes: Holding herself back

[url=/c119876]Mio[/url]'s friend who is like a second older sister to Shun, as she takes care of the household chores for him due to Mio being busy with work. She is understanding of Shun's circumstances and keeps a certain distance from him, but at times she'll also pamper him with her "sisterly love." Similarly to [url=/c119868]Hinano[/url], Ayane becomes more aggressive in her pursuit for Shun after [url=/c119867]Ena[/url]'s confession, as she realizes she wants Shun all to herself. She likes sexual things and is open to trying out any kind of sexual plays.
